title: VP - Platform
description:
**About Ginesys**

Ginesys is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1,200+ customers and 50,000+ users through the unified GinesysOne suite — ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX). We are evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through Ginesys.AI.

**Role Summary**

The VP Platform runs the current infrastructure while building the target platform. This is an operating role and a transformation role.

The role keeps existing SaaS environments stable, builds the new cloud-native platform, owns the Oracle to Postgres migration pipeline, establishes the security practice, and brings platform engineering discipline into the way teams ship.

**What This Role Owns**

* Current SaaS infrastructure stability.
* Target cloud-native platform architecture and operations.
* Kubernetes, Postgres, Kafka, Redis, Kong, observability, and CI/CD platform foundations.
* Oracle to Postgres migration tooling, validation, rollback, and cutover support.
* Platform SLOs, incident response, on-call model, and environment controls.
* Security, network, access, secrets, WAF, and compliance readiness.
* DBA practice across Oracle legacy operations and PostgreSQL target operations.
* Platform team structure, hiring, standards, and capability building.

**What This Role Does Not Own**

* Product roadmap or commercial prioritization.
* Domain business rules owned by Supply Chain, Core Commerce, or Digital Commerce.
* Architecture authority for bounded contexts, which sits with the Chief Architect and Technical Design Council.
* Program status governance, which sits with the Transformation Program Lead.
* Embedded engineering delivery inside domain squads.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Operations**

* Own infrastructure across current and target environments.
* Define and operate platform SLOs.
* Manage environment provisioning, access, capacity, and decommissioning.
* Reduce cloud waste through shared infrastructure, capacity discipline, and retention controls.

**Target Platform**

* Build the shared platform foundation for Kubernetes, Postgres, Kafka, Redis, Kong, observability, and CI/CD.
* Establish standards for deployments, secrets, networking, monitoring, tracing, and release automation.
* Make platform capabilities usable by domain teams without each team having to invent its own tooling.

**Migration Engineering**

* Own the Oracle to Postgres migration pipeline with the migration engineering team.
* Define migration throughput, data validation, rollback readiness, and post-migration checks.
* Work with domain teams and Principal QA on parity, shadow, pilot, and cutover readiness.

**Security And Reliability**

* Build the security practice and baseline controls.
* Establish incident response, on-call, alerting, and production review practices.
* Drive SOC2 / ISO 27001 readiness where needed.

**Team Building**

* Lead a distributed platform organization across infrastructure, DBA, security, DevOps/SRE, internal IT, and migration engineering.
* Hire senior platform, security, SRE, and DevOps talent where the current team has gaps.
* Grow junior engineers into a disciplined platform practice.

**Required Experience**

* 15+ years in infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, database operations, or cloud operations.
* Experience leading teams of meaningful size and mixed seniority.
* Deep experience in at least two of Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS, Kafka, observability, or security operations.
* Experience running production systems while modernizing them.
* Strong understanding of multi-tenant SaaS operations, access control, reliability, and incident management.
Hands-on comfort with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD tooling.  

  

**Helpful Experience**

* Oracle to Postgres migration experience.
* Retail, ERP, POS, OMS, or e-commerce platform experience.
* Experience building a platform team from an early stage.
* Familiarity with .NET, Java/Spring Boot, and mixed-stack modernization.
* Compliance exposure, including ISO 27001, SOC2, penetration testing, or security audits.

**Benefits**:

We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as:

Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development

Comprehensive health insurance coverage

Excellent rewards and recognition policy

Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC

Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year

Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country.

Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events

Quarterly Coffee with CEO and more!

**Here’s our story; now tell us yours**

“Ginesys One” is India’s best omni retail suite backed by Ginesys, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online retail, offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 400+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionize retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite.

We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Coimbatore & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite.

Ginesys core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers. We are an ISO-certified and SOC compliant company having won myriad awards for our innovation and support. For further information, please visit our website http://ginesys.in

BGV will be conducted by a third-party agency, and any discrepancies or failure in the verification process will lead to immediate termination of employment.

title: Trainer Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Job Title:** Associate - Trainer Acquisition

**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India

**Workplace Type:** On-site

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About iamneo**

Founded in 2016 and now part of the NIIT family, iamneo is a fast-growing, profitable B2B EdTech SaaS company transforming how tech talent is upskilled, evaluated, and deployed. Our AI-powered learning and assessment platforms help enterprises and educational institutions build future-ready talent at scale.

We specialize in Talent Upskilling, Assessment, and Workforce Transformation across sectors such as ITeS, BFSI, and Higher Education. Our solutions are trusted by top corporates, including LTIMindtree, Virtusa, Tech Mahindra, and Hexaware, as well as 150+ leading institutions such as VIT, SRM, LPU, Sri Krishna Institutions, and Manipal. If you're driven by innovation and want to shape the future of tech learning, iamneo is where you belong

**About the Role**

We are looking for a driven and detail-oriented Associate - Trainer Acquisition to join our team. In this role, you will own end-to-end recruitment activities, including sourcing, screening, and onboarding top talent. You will contribute to hiring talent that supports iamneo's core product suite — NeoPAT, NeoColab, NeoHire, and NeoCoder

**Key Responsibilities**

**Recruitment and Coordination**

* Manage the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and onboarding support
* Source candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed), employee referrals, social media, and campus hiring initiatives
* Screen resumes and conduct initial telephonic or video interviews to assess candidate fitment
* Schedule and drive interview rounds with hiring managers and internal stakeholders
* Manage requisitions, pipeline tracking, and candidate records in Keka Hire. Use Keka HR for offer management, onboarding initiation, and headcount reporting
* Draft and post job descriptions across multiple hiring platforms
* Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline for current and future hiring needs
* Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process
* Own bulk hiring and lateral hiring initiatives as assigned
* Use Claude to draft and refine job descriptions, generate structured interview question banks, summarise candidate evaluation notes, and build hiring status updates for business stakeholders and support hiring automation workflows

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and hiring priorities
* Own the handoff to HR Ops, onboarding, and payroll for seamless candidate transition
* Ensure timely communication with candidates and stakeholders throughout the hiring cycle

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of sourcing techniques and Boolean search.
* Good communication, coordination, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Willingness to learn HR processes, recruitment best practices, and hiring tools.

**Bonus Points**

* Internship or academic project experience in recruitment or HR.
* Familiarity with ATS platforms such as Keka Hire.
* Basic understanding of technical roles such as Software Engineers, QA, and Data Analysts.
* Interest in the EdTech or SaaS industry.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be part of a fast-growing EdTech company backed by the NIIT legacy.
* Gain exposure to diverse hiring domains — Tech, Product, Business, and Operations.
* Receive guidance and mentorship to build your recruitment skills.
* Learn hands-on sourcing techniques, Boolean search, and applicant tracking systems.
* Build a strong foundation for a career in Talent Acquisition and HR.

title: PRODUCTION ENGINEER – SMD/SMT
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**PRODUCTION ENGINEER – SMD/SMT**

**Job Title:** Production Engineer

**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

**Experience:** 3 years

**Salary:** ₹3.5–4.5 LPA

**Industry:** Electronics Manufacturing / SMD-SMT

**Job Summary**

Our client is looking for a Production Engineer with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in SMD/SMT electronics manufacturing. The candidate must be capable of taking end-to-end ownership of the production line, managing day-to-day operations, achieving production and quality targets, troubleshooting process issues, and preparing and implementing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

**Key Responsibilities**

· Take complete responsibility for day-to-day production line operations and ensure smooth line functioning.

· Manage SMD/SMT production processes and monitor machine operation, output, and workflow.

· Plan and monitor production schedules, allocate manpower, and achieve daily production targets.

· Prepare, document, implement, review, and update SOPs and work instructions for production processes.

· Monitor line efficiency, productivity, machine downtime, rejection rates, and production performance.

· Troubleshoot production and process-related issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.

· Coordinate with quality, maintenance, stores, and other departments to ensure uninterrupted production.

· Ensure product quality, process compliance, workplace safety, and adherence to manufacturing procedures.

· Identify bottlenecks, reduce wastage, and implement continuous improvement initiatives.

· Maintain daily production reports, downtime records, rejection data, and other manufacturing documentation.

· Supervise and guide production operators and ensure compliance with defined work instructions.

**Required Qualifications**

· Diploma or BE/BTech in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.

· Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in electronics manufacturing or SMD/SMT production.

· Hands-on SMD/SMT production experience and proven ability to independently handle a production line.

· Practical experience in preparing and implementing SOPs and work instructions.

· Knowledge of production planning, process troubleshooting, quality control, and manpower management.

**Required Skills**

· SMD/SMT Production Line Management

· Production Planning and Control

· SMD Machine Operation and Monitoring

· SOP Preparation and Implementation

· Manpower Handling and Line Supervision

· Production Target Achievement

· Machine Troubleshooting and Downtime Reduction

· Quality Control and Defect Analysis

· Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective/Preventive Actions

· Line Efficiency and Productivity Improvement

· 5S and Lean Manufacturing

· Production Documentation and Reporting

· Cross-functional Team Coordination

· Safety Standards and Process Compliance

Preferred Technical Skills

· SMT pick-and-place machines

· Solder paste printing and reflow oven processes

· PCB assembly and inspection

· ESD handling and prevention

· First Pass Yield (FPY) and rejection analysis

· Preventive maintenance coordination

· Microsoft Excel and production MIS reporting

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

A hands-on, accountable Production Engineer who can independently manage the complete production line, lead operators, prepare and maintain SOPs, resolve production issues, and consistently meet production targets without compromising quality or safety.

**Compensation: ₹3.5–4.5 LPA, depending on relevant experience and skills.**

Pay: ₹350,000.00 - ₹450,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
